scope: First 40 unresolved private nonprofit institutions in state-and-name order after the 2026-08-27 public-institution closeout, excluding institutions already recorded as held.
safeguards: Only official institution pages, institution-exclusive ATS sites, or shared boards with a durable exact institution boundary were promoted.
Student and alumni job boards, stale individual advertisements, broad parent-company feeds, and sources that could not be scoped to the named institution were held.
Merged, transitioning, or apparently closed institutions were held unless a current independent employee source was verified.
Existing production routes were reconciled into coverage metadata instead of duplicated.
